Subject: Request: extended trial allowance for academic LLM evaluation

Hi Rachel,

I'm Linda Chou, PI for the Cognitive Systems Lab at Granville University. We signed up for Redwood during the free PLG trial and have been running preliminary evaluations against a literature-summary use case. The test looks promising and we'd like to expand scope to include large-batch embedding experiments and multi-turn generation for an IR evaluation.

Current trial exhausted earlier than expected because several team members experimented in parallel. Would Redwood consider a university research allowance (trial extension / promotional allocation) so we can run a reproducible evaluation over the next 6 weeks? Rough ask: ~150k token allowance and 10k embedding units.

Attached is a letter on departmental letterhead confirming academic status and the short research summary. Happy to provide additional procurement info if required. We are not yet under a procurement contract — this is an academic access request.

Thanks,

Linda
Prof. Linda Chou
Cognitive Systems Lab, Granville University
l.chou@granville.edu
(attached: granville_affiliation_letter.pdf, research_statement_excerpt.pdf)

Hi Linda — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the docs.

Short answer: yes, we can often issue an academic trial allowance for university research groups. I'll need a quick internal approval for the size (150k tokens / 10k embeddings) and a confirmation of intended evaluation dates. Can you confirm start date (you mentioned "next 6 weeks" — what is the target kickoff?) and the list of Redwood account emails that should receive the allowance?

Next steps I will take now: 1) loop in our access provisioning team (cc'd: Dev Patel) for evaluation of the ask; 2) if approved we create a self-serve redemption token and send instructions for activation in the project settings page.

If you prefer a short call, I can do 20 minutes tomorrow afternoon (ET).

Best,
Rachel Kim

Hi Linda —

Good news: we've approved a promotional trial allowance for Granville University's Cognitive Systems Lab. Details below and next steps to activate.

Allowance details:
- Promo code: GV-ACA-150K-2026
- Token allowance: 150,000 tokens (generation / chat)
- Embedding units: 10,000 units
- Activation window: redeem by 2026-08-01; once redeemed the allowance is valid for 6 weeks
- Restrictions: hosted API only; not combinable with other promos; single-use per email/account

Activation steps (self-serve):
1) Sign in to the lab's primary account at https://console.redwood.inference.com -> Billing -> Promotions
2) Click "Redeem promo code" and enter GV-ACA-150K-2026
3) Confirm billing contact and project's primary email; the allowance will appear in the account balance immediately after applying

I've copied Dev Patel who will provision the code in the system and can escalate if you hit any issues. For program reporting, please send a short checklist of experiments you run (top-level metrics are fine) so our research partnerships team can track education outcomes.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 20-minute onboarding call to walk your students through embedding best-practices and batching recommendations.

Best,
Rachel
